
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zhennann/p/19221424" title="发布于 2025-11-14 11:46">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">VonaJS: 序列化/数据脱敏(下)</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1462384/202511/1462384-20251114114538939-363955830.png" alt="VonaJS: 序列化/数据脱敏(下)" class="desc_img">
        VonaJS 提供了序列化能力，可以对 API 的响应数据进行转换，比如：排除密码字段，对 Email 和 Mobile 进行脱敏处理，等等。前文介绍了序列化的一般用法。这里再介绍一组工具函数。通过工具函数可以更加便利的使用序列化能力
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>VonaJS 提供了<code>序列化</code>能力，可以对 API 的响应数据进行转换，比如：排除密码字段，对 Email 和 Mobile 进行脱敏处理，等等</p>
<p>前文介绍了<code>序列化</code>的一般用法。这里再介绍一组工具函数。通过工具函数可以更加便利的使用序列化能力</p>
<h2 id="工具清单">工具清单</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>工具: @Serializer</th>
<th>工具: v</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>@Serializer.transform</td>
<td>v.serializerTransform</td>
<td>使用Serializer Transform，参见: <a href="https://vona.js.org/zh/guide/techniques/serialization/introduction.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">序列化</a></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>@Serializer.exclude</td>
<td>v.serializerExclude</td>
<td>排除字段</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>@Serializer.replace</td>
<td>v.serializerReplace</td>
<td>对字段值进行脱敏处理</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>@Serializer.getter</td>
<td>v.serializerGetter</td>
<td>采用getter机制生成新的字段值</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>@Serializer.custom</td>
<td>v.serializerCustom</td>
<td>使用自定义函数对字段值进行处理</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<pre><code class="language-bash">既然`@Serializer`工具非常简洁，直观，为什么还要提供`v`工具？

1. `v`工具可以实现通过 App Config 修改配置
2. `v`工具和`@Serializer`工具底层逻辑是一致的
</code></pre>
<h2 id="serializertransformvserializertransform">@Serializer.transform/v.serializerTransform</h2>
<p>比如，将<code>EntityStudent</code>中的<code>name</code>字段值转化为大写</p>
<p>我们直接使用<a href="https://vona.js.org/zh/guide/techniques/serialization/introduction.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">序列化</a>中创建的 Serializer Transform <code>upper</code></p>
<h3 id="1-serializertransform">1. @Serializer.transform</h3>
<pre><code class="language-diff">class EntityStudent {
+ @Serializer.transform('demo-student:upper')
  @Api.field(v.title($locale('Name')))
  name: string;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-vserializertransform">2. v.serializerTransform</h3>
<pre><code class="language-diff">class EntityStudent {
+ @Api.field(v.serializerTransform('demo-student:upper'), v.title($locale('Name')))
  name: string;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-app-config">3. App Config</h3>
<p>可以在 App Config 中修改配置</p>
<p><code>src/backend/config/config/config.ts</code></p>
<ul>
<li>方法 1: 直接修改 Openapi 参数</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">// onions
config.onions = {
  entity: {
    'demo-student:student': {
      fields: {
        name: {
          serializerTransforms: {
            'demo-student:upper': {},
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
};
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>方法 2: 构造一个新的 schema</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">import { $makeSchema, v } from 'vona-module-a-openapi';

// onions
config.onions = {
  entity: {
    'demo-student:student': {
      fields: {
        name: $makeSchema(v.serializerTransform('demo-student:upper'), z.string()),
      },
    },
  },
};
</code></pre>
<h2 id="serializerexcludevserializerexclude">@Serializer.exclude/v.serializerExclude</h2>
<p>比如，排除<code>EntityStudent</code>中的<code>name</code>字段</p>
<h3 id="1-serializerexclude">1. @Serializer.exclude</h3>
<pre><code class="language-diff">class EntityStudent {
+ @Serializer.exclude()
  @Api.field(v.title($locale('Name')))
  name: string;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-vserializerexclude">2. v.serializerExclude</h3>
<pre><code class="language-diff">class EntityStudent {
+ @Api.field(v.serializerExclude(), v.title($locale('Name')))
  name: string;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-app-config-1">3. App Config</h3>
<p>可以在 App Config 中修改配置</p>
<p><code>src/backend/config/config/config.ts</code></p>
<ul>
<li>方法 1: 直接修改 Openapi 参数</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">// onions
config.onions = {
  entity: {
    'demo-student:student': {
      fields: {
        name: { exclude: false },
      },
    },
  },
};
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>方法 2: 构造一个新的 schema</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">import { $makeSchema, v } from 'vona-module-a-openapi';

// onions
config.onions = {
  entity: {
    'demo-student:student': {
      fields: {
        name: $makeSchema(v.serializerExclude(), z.string()),
      },
    },
  },
};
</code></pre>
<h2 id="serializerreplacevserializerreplace">@Serializer.replace/v.serializerReplace</h2>
<p>比如，将<code>EntityStudent</code>中的<code>name</code>字段值进行脱敏处理</p>
<p>比如，name 原始值为<code>tom</code>，脱敏之后为<code>t***m</code></p>
<h3 id="1-serializerreplace">1. @Serializer.replace</h3>
<pre><code class="language-diff">class EntityStudent {
+ @Serializer.replace({ patternFrom: /(\w)(\w+)(\w)/, patternTo: '$1***$3' })
  @Api.field(v.title($locale('Name')))
  name: string;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-vserializerreplace">2. v.serializerReplace</h3>
<pre><code class="language-diff">class EntityStudent {
  @Api.field(
+   v.serializerReplace({ patternFrom: /(\w)(\w+)(\w)/, patternTo: '$1***$3' }),
    v.title($locale('Name')),
  )
  name: string;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-app-config-2">3. App Config</h3>
<p>可以在 App Config 中修改配置</p>
<p><code>src/backend/config/config/config.ts</code></p>
<ul>
<li>方法 1: 直接修改 Openapi 参数</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">// onions
config.onions = {
  entity: {
    'demo-student:student': {
      fields: {
        name: {
          serializerTransforms: {
            'a-serialization:replace': {
              patternFrom: /(\w)(\w+)(\w)/,
              patternTo: '$1***$3',
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
};
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><code>a-serialization:replace</code>: <code>a-serialization</code>模块提供的 Serializer Transform</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li>方法 2: 构造一个新的 schema</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">import { $makeSchema, v } from 'vona-module-a-openapi';

// onions
config.onions = {
  entity: {
    'demo-student:student': {
      fields: {
        name: $makeSchema(
          v.serializerReplace({ patternFrom: /(\w)(\w+)(\w)/, patternTo: '$1***$3' }),
          z.string(),
        ),
      },
    },
  },
};
</code></pre>
<h2 id="serializergettervserializergetter">@Serializer.getter/v.serializerGetter</h2>
<p>比如，<code>EntityStudent</code>中的<code>fullName</code>字段由<code>firstName</code>和<code>lastName</code>字段组合而成</p>
<h3 id="1-getter">1. getter</h3>
<pre><code class="language-diff">class EntityStudent {
  @Api.field()
  firstName: string;

  @Api.field()
  lastName: string;

  @Api.field()
+ get fullName(): string | undefined {
+   return `${this.firstName} ${this.lastName}`;
+ }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-serializergetter">2. @Serializer.getter</h3>
<pre><code class="language-diff">class EntityStudent {
+ @Serializer.getter((data: EntityStudent) =&gt; {
+   return `${data.firstName} ${data.lastName}`;
+ })
  @Api.field()
  fullName: string;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-vserializergetter">3. v.serializerGetter</h3>
<pre><code class="language-diff">class EntityStudent {
+ @Api.field(v.serializerGetter((data: EntityStudent) =&gt; {
+   return `${data.firstName} ${data.lastName}`;
+ }))
  fullName: string;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-app-config">4. App Config</h3>
<p>可以在 App Config 中修改配置</p>
<p><code>src/backend/config/config/config.ts</code></p>
<ul>
<li>方法 1: 直接修改 Openapi 参数</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">// onions
config.onions = {
  entity: {
    'demo-student:student': {
      fields: {
        fullName: {
          serializerTransforms: {
            'a-serialization:getter': {
              getter: (data: EntityStudent) =&gt; {
                return `${data.firstName} ${data.lastName}`;
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
};
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><code>a-serialization:getter</code>: <code>a-serialization</code>模块提供的 Serializer Transform</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li>方法 2: 构造一个新的 schema</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">import { $makeSchema, v } from 'vona-module-a-openapi';

// onions
config.onions = {
  entity: {
    'demo-student:student': {
      fields: {
        fullName: $makeSchema(
          v.serializerGetter((data: EntityStudent) =&gt; {
            return `${data.firstName} ${data.lastName}`;
          }),
          z.string(),
        ),
      },
    },
  },
};
</code></pre>
<h2 id="serializercustomvserializercustom">@Serializer.custom/v.serializerCustom</h2>
<p>比如，将<code>EntityStudent</code>中的<code>name</code>字段值转换为大写</p>
<h3 id="1-serializercustom">1. @Serializer.custom</h3>
<pre><code class="language-diff">class EntityStudent {
+ @Serializer.custom((value: string) =&gt; {
+   return value.toUpperCase();
+ })
  @Api.field(v.title($locale('Name')))
  name: string;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-vserializercustom">2. v.serializerCustom</h3>
<pre><code class="language-diff">class EntityStudent {
  @Api.field(
+   v.serializerCustom((value: string) =&gt; {
+     return value.toUpperCase();
+   }),
    v.title($locale('Name')),
  )
  name: string;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-app-config-3">3. App Config</h3>
<p>可以在 App Config 中修改配置</p>
<p><code>src/backend/config/config/config.ts</code></p>
<ul>
<li>方法 1: 直接修改 Openapi 参数</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">// onions
config.onions = {
  entity: {
    'demo-student:student': {
      fields: {
        name: {
          serializerTransforms: {
            'a-serialization:custom': {
              custom: (value: string) =&gt; {
                return value.toUpperCase();
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
};
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><code>a-serialization:custom</code>: <code>a-serialization</code>模块提供的 Serializer Transform</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li>方法 2: 构造一个新的 schema</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-typescript">import { $makeSchema, v } from 'vona-module-a-openapi';

// onions
config.onions = {
  entity: {
    'demo-student:student': {
      fields: {
        name: $makeSchema(
          v.serializerCustom((value: string) =&gt; {
            return value.toUpperCase();
          }),
          z.string(),
        ),
      },
    },
  },
};
</code></pre>
